title: The Grinning Surgeon
text: A man in a bloody apron has set up a table by the road, his saws and needles laid out in a neat, gleaming row. He smiles at every wound he sees, wider for the worse ones. He has fixed a great many people, he says, and he offers to fix one of yours.

options.label: Let him work on the one who needs it most, and pray his skill is as fine as his smile.

outcomes.text: His hands are quick and clean, and when he is done the old wound is gone, as if it had never been.
He fixes it, and while he is in there he leaves a little something of his own. He is still smiling when he sews it shut.

options.label: Decline politely, and keep well clear of the saws.

outcomes.text: He shrugs, and goes on smiling, and wipes a blade on his apron as you pass. The Leader keeps seeing that blade when they close their eyes.
